purpose: Test whether the measured Liger fused-cross-entropy implementation effect can cause a reproducible training collapse, first under controlled amplification and then without amplification.

implementation.candidate: Liger fused linear cross entropy with BF16 dW chunk accumulation
implementation.repair: The same Liger implementation and chunking with FP32 dW accumulation
implementation.changed_boundary: Only the accumulation dtype of the fused loss weight gradient

optimizer.name: AdamW with FP32 master parameters and moments

calibration.purpose: Freeze one direction and measure the natural candidate-minus-repair AdamW update scale before collapse searches.

injection.interpretation: Injected experiments establish susceptibility to a measured implementation-shaped update. They do not establish natural candidate collapse.

discovery.rule: Increase the multiplier in the frozen order. Stop after the first reproducible collapse bracket or when the relative injected RMS exceeds the cap.

collapse_definition.nonfinite: Candidate develops a non-finite loss, gradient, update, or parameter while the matched repair remains finite for at least 512 additional steps.

additional_requirements: Validation loss is worse at three frozen checkpoints.
The candidate does not recover before the frozen horizon.

claim_boundary: The small-model search is a controlled full-parameter susceptibility experiment. Only repeated unamplified NATURAL_CANDIDATE failure against stable NATURAL_REPAIR supports a natural single-boundary collapse claim.
